hedges.reason: This is the only candidate linked to broad crypto risk appetite that is not the LAPTOP token itself. In the risk-on, memecoin-mania worlds where LAPTOP holds nine figures, retail and liquidity flowing into new crypto launches would also tend to lift Tread's FDV one day after its launch. It is a weak proxy. Tread's launch timing may not overlap with LAPTOP's, Tread may not launch at all, and Tread's valuation depends on its own fundamentals and airdrop design. That is why I would only size it mildly and would not make a hard claim on it.
